findings.title: Leadership as a stable alignment
findings.claim: The appointed guides can be read as a stable line of direction: they lead from the front under divine command, and patience and certainty keep that direction steady amid people who turn from signs.
findings.mechanism: The focus pairs an appointed group with active guidance by command. The pericope sets that work beside rejection of signs in 32:22 and a later sign-and-hearing scene in 32:26. The command supplies a mandate, followable leaders carry the direction, self-restraint sustains it, and certainty fixes it.
findings.reader_payoff: Leadership becomes a maintained orientation for a community, not a title alone.
findings.containment: The retained image is a followable guide whose direction remains under command and signs. The candidate's builder and pillar analogy is excluded because its cited branches have no registered glosses or facets; no literal construction or complete governance model is claimed.

epistemic.reason: The focus branches and trusted channel support are supplied, while the candidate's structural extension depends on two unresolved branch citations that are excluded.

findings.title: Guidance moves from Book to people
findings.claim: The leaders can be read as the Book's guidance made socially followable: what is first given as a written guide takes human form among its recipient community.
findings.mechanism: The shift is from the baseline that leaders possess guidance alongside the Book to a relay: 32:23 makes the Book guidance for Israel, and 32:24 makes some from them leaders who guide by the divine command. The repeated making and guidance contact changes the medium from written composition to followable people without changing the source.
findings.reader_payoff: Guidance is seen as both a received text and a human practice that others can follow.
findings.containment: The focus still says that leaders guide under command. The relay is an inference from consecutive repeated wording; a live alternative is that the Book and leaders are parallel gifts with no succession of media.

epistemic.reason: Exact Arabic and consecutive repetition are supplied, but HFT segmentation, context roots, and the transfer from text to people remain attributed.

findings.title: Guidance as a life-bearing conduit
findings.claim: The leaders may be conduits that carry a life-bearing divine affair toward seemingly closed ground, waiting for growth whose source and fruit exceed them.
findings.mechanism: The baseline is that leaders deliver teachings to listeners. The focus roots guidance in أمرنا and links leadership to patience; 32:27 then supplies directed water, barren land, emergence, growth, nourishment, and sight. This material transfer sequence gives the focus a conduit analogy: leaders carry what they do not own, and patience spans the unseen delay before yield.
findings.reader_payoff: Guidance becomes transmission with delayed, shared fruit rather than possession of a teaching by its human carrier.
findings.containment: The water scene may function only as evidence of resurrection and provision, with no leadership model intended; a supplied connection also calls its relation to focus certainty indirect and includes contrary evidence. Keep the conduit as an exploratory analogy, not a lexical meaning of guidance or command.

epistemic.reason: The 32:27 sequence is supplied, but its mapping to leadership is an explicitly analogical HFT inference with a live non-analogy alternative.

findings.title: Patience in an open response interval
findings.claim: The focus patience can also govern present leadership: the guides sustain non-coercive direction through delay while response can still benefit, without seizing the final opening.
findings.mechanism: The baseline makes patience the past condition for appointment. The pericope then asks when the opening will come, names a day after which faith no longer benefits and respite is withheld, and ends with turning aside and waiting. That before-and-after sequence places the leaders' patience in the still-open interval of response.
findings.reader_payoff: Patience becomes stewardship of a live opportunity for response, not only a quality that earned leadership in the past.
findings.containment: The timing contrast may concern only the opponents and may not redefine leadership patience; a supplied connection note also says 32:30's turning and waiting does not materially clarify the focus. This remains an attributed pericope reading, not a claim that leaders control the opening.

epistemic.reason: The focus and 32:28–30 surfaces are exact, but the link from the opponents' timing exchange to present leadership is explicitly an HFT inference.

findings.title: Guidance as a shared orientation
findings.claim: The leaders also stabilize communal orientation: they hold a followable heading toward signs against the bodily tendency to turn away from them.
findings.mechanism: The baseline makes leaders communicators of propositions. Focus branches for aiming and direction meet the 32:22 signs and the act of turning aside; the packet therefore offers a spatial model in which a front-positioned guide helps a community keep its heading.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees guidance as a direction people can face and follow, not only information they may accept or reject.
findings.containment: The HFT explicitly treats this as a surprising spatial model across roots, not an etymological equation. The ordinary focus remains leaders who guide and are certain in signs; the context segmentation and roots are attributed, and no physical compass or sign-location is claimed.

epistemic.reason: Focus branches for aiming and direction are registered, while the contextual word segmentation and the spatial assembly are HFT-attributed.

findings.title: Guidance with a destructive edge
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the guidance word may also carry a destructive edge: when a false obstruction blocks the route, guidance can clear it so movement becomes possible.
findings.mechanism: The baseline is that guidance only points gently toward an available route. The packet's registered focus branch for heavy breaking meets the HFT-located turning-aside/obstruction and destruction context; the branch makes a possible clearing action available while the ordinary guidance branch remains the anchor.
findings.reader_payoff: Guidance gains a disruptive possibility: sometimes a route opens when an obstruction is broken, not only when a direction is indicated.
findings.containment: This is form-distant and exploratory, never a replacement translation for يهدون. The HFT containment calls the mapping ه د د, while the supplied root_001580/B001 branch is registered under ه د ي and the trace's root and focus coordinate also say ه د ي; that wording conflict remains unresolved. Gentle path-indication governs the reading.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch has a supplied gloss and exact focus occurrence, but the contextual obstruction mechanism is an HFT attribution and the source contains an unresolved root-label discrepancy.

findings.title: Patience as layered storage
findings.claim: Exploratorily, patience can be pictured as layered storage: capacity gathers without spectacle until it is released as nourishment and visible growth.
findings.mechanism: The baseline is static withholding until hardship passes. The focus-root cloud branch supplies layered accumulation; in 32:27 water reaches barren land and growth emerges, providing an independent delayed-yield trigger that turns patience into latent capacity.
findings.reader_payoff: Patience becomes productive hidden accumulation rather than empty waiting.
findings.containment: The cloud branch is materially distant from the focus verb. Keep it only as a metaphor activated by the later water-to-growth sequence, never as the lexical meaning of صبروا. The ecological scene may still function only as a sign of resurrection and provision.

epistemic.reason: The registered branch and exact context sequence are supplied, but their connection is explicitly metaphorical and HFT-attributed.

findings.title: A command with a sign and time edge
findings.claim: The divine أمر that authorizes guidance can also brush against a sign-and-appointment field: the pericope presents signs to heed and an opening whose day is named.
findings.mechanism: The focus word أمرنا is the carrier. Its registered branch has a sign-marker core and an appointed-time extension. Focus certainty in signs and the 32:26 historical signs activate the marker edge; the question about when the opening will come and the answer naming its day activate the timing edge. The result places guidance under signs and a divine schedule.
findings.reader_payoff: The phrase can be heard as more than a mandate: it sits within a pericope where signs direct attention and the final opening has a named time.
findings.containment: This remains a contextual resonance, not an alternate translation of أمرنا; the ordinary command or affair sense stays intact. The passage does not say that the leaders know or control the opening's time, and the timing exchange may concern the opponents alone.

epistemic.reason: The branch and focus sign occurrence are registered, while the contextual appointment contact depends on attributed HFT anchors and remains an inference.

friction_notes: The focus_word_alignment maps all 14 analysis units to QAC morphemes with no unresolved units. Context anchors beyond the focus supply exact Arabic but no target morphology; their HFT word indices, roots, and roles remain attributed.
All eight HFT candidates mark their packet scope as broader than the declared pericope, while their explicit anchor sets are complete and fall within 32:21–30. No wider context is used.

The demolition outlier's containment calls the mapping ه د د, but registered root_001580/B001 and its HFT trace give ه د ي at focus 32:24:4. Its branch remains available as an exploratory same-root reading; the wording discrepancy is unresolved.
The automatic 32:0 basmala is included as ordinary macro context, but the supplied packet gives no independent trigger-to-focus contact from it, so no finding uses it.
